requirements.description: A bachelor's degree in Informatics equivalent to the TUM BSc Informatics; other programmes do not qualify. Two-stage aptitude assessment including a 90-minute written test in English.
Taught in English; English language proficiency is required and no minimum TOEFL/IELTS score is published on the programme page.

GRE General or Indian GATE (CS) is mandatory for applicants with degrees from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran or Pakistan; a uni-assist VPD is required for applicants with a non-German bachelor's degree.

fees.notes: Non-EU master's tuition EUR 4,000-6,000 per semester (EUR 8,000-12,000 per year); the amount shown is the top of the published band. Plus a semester contribution of about EUR 85-97 per semester.

requirements.description: A bachelor's degree in a related quantitative field; a bachelor's with 70% or CGPA 7.5/10 is the commonly cited guidance, but no programme-specific threshold is stated on the programme page.
Taught in English; English language proficiency is required and no minimum TOEFL/IELTS score is published on the programme page.
